era: classic / modern strategy, MMO, and digital card game
summary: Warcraft franchise entries added as supplemental sourced guide rows; Sami did not list these in the locked personal spine.

entries.title: Warcraft: Orcs & Humans

emulation.notes: Native Windows remaster. DOSBox only for original-version comparison.

primary.why: Warcraft: Orcs & Humans released on MS-DOS and Mac OS, then received a Windows-only Remastered release in 2024. Windows Remastered is the best archive route because it adds modern visuals and controls while preserving the original as a comparison mode.
primary.how_to_play: Use Warcraft I: Remastered on Windows through Battle.net or Game Pass where available. Use the original DOS/Mac releases only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Remastered is Windows-only; Mac users must preserve the original Mac release separately.

entries.title: Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness

emulation.notes: Native Windows remaster. Use DOSBox/console emulation only for comparison.

primary.why: Warcraft II released on DOS/Mac, received console ports, a Battle.net Edition, and a Windows-only Remastered release in 2024. Windows Remastered is the best archive route because it is the current high-fidelity package with modern controls and presentation.
primary.how_to_play: Use Warcraft II: Remastered on Windows. Use console ports or the original/Battle.net Edition only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Remastered is Windows-only; older Mac/console routes remain historical comparison.

entries.title: Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos
entries.definitive_edition: Current Warcraft III: Reforged on Windows

primary.why: Warcraft III released for Windows and Mac, then was remastered as Warcraft III: Reforged. The current Windows Reforged client is the highest-fidelity route and includes modern Battle.net support, while the original client/legacy option remains important for historical comparison.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Warcraft III: Reforged Windows client. Use classic graphics or legacy client options for comparison where available.

entries.remaster_caveats: Reforged had a controversial launch; capture the current 2.0-era state and preserve legacy client behavior separately.

entries.title: Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne
entries.definitive_edition: Current Warcraft III: Reforged on Windows

primary.version: Current Warcraft III: Reforged / Frozen Throne campaign
primary.why: The Frozen Throne released for Windows and Mac as the Warcraft III expansion and is included in the Reforged package. Current Windows Reforged is the highest-fidelity archive route for the campaign, with legacy-client behavior preserved separately for comparison.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Warcraft III: Reforged Windows client and play The Frozen Throne campaign after Reign of Chaos.

entries.remaster_caveats: Reforged includes The Frozen Throne but has legacy-client preservation caveats.

entries.title: World of Warcraft

primary.version: Current retail client with current expansion access
primary.why: World of Warcraft released for Windows and macOS and continues through major expansions, including Midnight in 2026. Windows is the best archive route because it has the broadest capture/settings ecosystem for the current retail MMO client.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows retail client and document expansion, patch, realm, and service state at capture time. Treat World of Warcraft Classic as a separate entry.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service MMO; archive exact expansion, patch, and realm state. Classic is represented separately.

entries.title: World of Warcraft Classic

primary.why: World of Warcraft Classic launched as a separate live-service route for legacy-era WoW content on Windows and macOS. Windows is the best archive route because it has the broadest capture/settings path.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows Classic client and document era, realm type, patch, and seasonal ruleset at capture time.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service Classic route; document era, season, realm, and patch.

entries.title: Hearthstone

primary.why: Hearthstone released for Windows and macOS, then iOS and Android. Windows is the best archive route because it has the strongest capture/display path for the current live-service card game.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows client and document expansion/standard rotation and patch state at capture time.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service card game; card sets and modes change over time.

entries.title: Warcraft Rumble

primary.why: Warcraft Rumble launched on iOS and Android, then reached Windows in 2024. Windows is the best archive route because it has the strongest capture/display path for the current live-service strategy game.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows client where available and document service/patch state at capture time.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service mobile/PC strategy game; document current event and patch state.
